evals.prompt: I have a web app using ZXing-js (@zxing/library + @zxing/browser) to continuously scan multiple barcodes by re-decoding the video feed and collecting distinct values. I want to replace it with Scandit MatrixScan Batch so all visible barcodes are tracked at once. It needs to keep reading EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128, and QR. Here is the scanner: zxing-scanner.ts.
evals.expected_output: The skill removes the ZXing-js APIs (BrowserMultiFormatReader, decodeFromVideoDevice, BarcodeFormat/DecodeHintType hints, the <video> element) and replaces them with MatrixScan Batch: DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey, BarcodeBatchSettings with EAN13UPCA + Code128 + QR, BarcodeBatch.forContext, a DataCaptureView, a BarcodeBatchBasicOverlay, and an IBarcodeBatchListener.didUpdateSession that iterates session.addedTrackedBarcodes. The ScannedBarcode interface and the dedupe/accumulate logic are preserved (dedupe stays keyed on barcode.data, because a barcode that leaves the frame and comes back gets a new tracking identifier). It maps ZXing BarcodeFormat to the correct web Symbology values, flags COOP/COEP as a new requirement, and shows a summary.

assertions.text: The @zxing/library and @zxing/browser imports are NOT present in the migrated code block (may appear in a before/after summary)
BrowserMultiFormatReader is NOT instantiated in the migrated code block (may appear in a summary table)
decodeFromVideoDevice is NOT called in the migrated code block
DecodeHintType and the POSSIBLE_FORMATS hint configuration are NOT present in the migrated code block
DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey( is used to create the context
BarcodeBatchSettings is created with new BarcodeBatchSettings()
await BarcodeBatch.forContext( is used as the async factory
Symbology.EAN13UPCA is enabled (mapped from BarcodeFormat.EAN_13 and BarcodeFormat.UPC_A)
Symbology.Code128 is enabled (mapped from BarcodeFormat.CODE_128)
Symbology.QR is enabled (mapped from BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE — not Symbology.QrCode, which does not exist on web)
Symbology.QrCode does NOT appear as a Symbology enum value in the migrated code (the deprecated/nonexistent web casing is not used)
A DataCaptureView is created (DataCaptureView.forContext or new DataCaptureView) and connected to the page with connectToElement (semantic)
BarcodeBatchBasicOverlay is created (withBarcodeBatchForView or withBarcodeBatchForViewWithStyle)
didUpdateSession is implemented on a BarcodeBatch listener
session.addedTrackedBarcodes is iterated for the new-this-frame barcodes (semantic)
trackedBarcode.barcode.data is read for the scanned value (replacing result.getText()) (semantic)
The ScannedBarcode interface (or equivalent data model) is preserved
Deduplication is preserved and keyed on the barcode data (trackedBarcode.barcode.data), not on trackedBarcode.identifier (semantic)
Cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP) headers are flagged as a new requirement that ZXing-js did not need (semantic)
Setup checklist mentions installing @scandit/web-datacapture-core and @scandit/web-datacapture-barcode
A summary of changes is shown describing what was removed (ZXing) and what was added (BarcodeBatch) (semantic)

evals.prompt: My shelf-audit web page uses the BarcodeDetector API (with the barcode-detector polyfill): getUserMedia into a <video>, detector.detect() every animation frame, a box drawn on a canvas over every barcode it finds, and each new EAN code added to a list. Replace it with Scandit MatrixScan Batch. Here is the code: barcode-detector-shelf.ts
evals.expected_output: The skill removes BarcodeDetector (the declare class, detect, the polyfill import), getUserMedia, the <video> stream, the requestAnimationFrame loop and the canvas boxes, and replaces them with MatrixScan Batch: DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey, BarcodeBatchSettings with exactly EAN13UPCA and EAN8 (ean_13 and upc_a both map to EAN13UPCA), BarcodeBatch.forContext, a DataCaptureView connected to an element, a BarcodeBatchBasicOverlay for the highlights, and didUpdateSession iterating session.addedTrackedBarcodes with trackedBarcode.barcode.data. The seen Set and ShelfItem list are kept, and the setup checklist removes barcode-detector and adds the COOP/COEP headers.

assertions.text: getUserMedia is NOT called in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
requestAnimationFrame is NOT called in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
barcode-detector/polyfill is NOT present in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
No BarcodeDetector is declared or constructed and no detect( call remains in the output code (semantic)
The hand-drawn canvas boxes (getContext("2d"), strokeRect) are not used in the output code; BarcodeBatchBasicOverlay draws the highlights (semantic)
BarcodeBatch.forContext( is present
BarcodeBatchBasicOverlay is present
settings.enableSymbologies(...) on BarcodeBatchSettings enables exactly Symbology.EAN13UPCA (from ean_13 and upc_a) and Symbology.EAN8, and nothing else
Symbology.UPCA is NOT present

UPC-A codes keep the 12-digit values BarcodeDetector returned: settings.settingsForSymbology(Symbology.EAN13UPCA).setExtensionEnabled("remove_leading_upca_zero", true) is set, or the summary flags that UPC-A codes now arrive as 13 digits with a leading zero (semantic)

The format stored in ShelfItem keeps the old BarcodeDetector format strings through a Symbology → old-string lookup (telling ean_13 from upc_a, which share EAN13UPCA), or the summary flags the changed format names (semantic)
didUpdateSession iterates session.addedTrackedBarcodes and reads trackedBarcode.barcode.data in place of rawValue
The seen Set dedupe on the code value and the ShelfItem list are preserved (semantic)
connectToElement( is present
Setup checklist says to remove the barcode-detector package (semantic)
Setup checklist mentions serving the page with Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp
